definitions.gloss: to confront; to face; to oppose
definitions.explanation: To bravely face a difficulty, challenge, or opponent rather than avoiding it. Implies courage and determination.

examples.english: To stand up against the enemy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: You need the courage to face problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to stand up against a large corporation alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かった⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The journalist who stood up against corruption received an award.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんなに→どんなに：03494_donnani⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逃|に}げず→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かった。
examples.english: No matter how tough the situation, she faced it head-on without running away.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). The thing being confronted takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, never ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう.

ASPECT: The plain past {立|た}ち{向|む}かった is the most common form, reporting a completed act of courage. ⟦ている→ている：30376_teiru⟧ is used of a sustained struggle (⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かっている, 'is fighting the illness'), not of a momentary stance.

USAGE: The object of {立|た}ち{向|む}かう is normally something formidable — an enemy, an injustice, a hardship — and the subject is framed as brave. It is not used for routine tasks; ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう implies a serious problem, not an exercise question.

FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) + ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (to face toward). The compound emphasizes taking a strong stance and actively confronting something.

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to face difficulties
・⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to stand up against an enemy
・⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to confront fate
・⟦{逆境|ぎゃっきょう}→逆境：22285_gyakkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{向|む}かう - to face adversity

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ - to challenge (the speaker takes the initiative and attacks)
・⟦{対峙|たいじ}→対峙：12357_taiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to confront (formal, written; two sides squared off)
・⟦{向|む}き{合|あ}う→向き合う：04652_mukiau⟧ - to face (neutral; no implication of courage or opposition)
